mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 76 degrees near the Verona Public Library, with a first quarter moon overhead.
The city council recently approved new sewer and stormwater rates to cover infrastructure costs, and we are also hiring for an Engineering Technician role at the Department of Public Works.
We have plenty to look forward to with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, and the Dane County Farmers Market taking over the square tomorrow.
In a notable call from Friday, August 15, police arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after finding her behind the wheel of a vehicle.
Enjoy the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist today, and if you are heading to the high school football game at 6 PM, keep an eye out for the Kona Ice truck!
